verified: TSMC Arizona Corporation's JETI application to the Texas Comptroller sets out a $22.6 billion project on a 3,232-acre site, construction spending from 2027, commercial operations in 2031, about $354 million in school-tax relief, and roughly 2,099 new hires; the Comptroller has recommended the application for approval.
unconfirmed: that TSMC will buy the land or build, that the school district and governor will approve the tax limitation, and that the budget is sufficient — Tom's Hardware estimates a single 20,000-wafer-per-month 2nm module costs $25 billion to $35 billion, above this plan's total.

verified: 德州审计长公开的 JETI 申请文件显示，TSMC Arizona 提交了这份 22.6 亿美元、约 3.54 亿美元学区税减免的申请，并列出逐年建筑与设备支出（设备支出在 2030 年达 90.5 亿美元峰值）、2,099 人的招聘计划，以及 2031 年投入商业运营、2032 年满产的时间表；审计长已建议批准。
unconfirmed: 台积电是否真的会买地建厂——文件未作任何承诺，公司称仍在评估；税减免尚未最终获批，须由学区和州长签署；文章同时指出，按业内估算单座 2nm 级、月产约 2 万片晶圆的厂区需 250 亿至 350 亿美元，22.6 亿美元低于该区间下限，且申请表格 Schedule A 截至 2031 年的合计为 216.6 亿美元，与 226 亿美元的总投资说法并不完全一致。

titles.en: TSMC files $22.6B Texas fab plan targeting 2nm-class output in 2031
titles.zh: 台积电申请德州226亿美元厂区，2nm级芯片最早2031年投产
